item.title: SECTOR 09 MAXED-OUT REBUILD ONLINE
item.description:
# WELCOME TO THE NEW NODE
All 19 interactive modules, flying **Chibi Cherubims & Seraphims**, **Wild Chaos Glitches**, and your permanent **GitHub CMS** are now live!
> Click any archive card to read it inside the full **Zine Reader**.
- Banish **7 flying cherubims/seraphims** to summon the 3-HP **Gilded Arch-Seraph Boss** - Enter the **Konami Code** (`↑↑↓↓←→←→BA`) to unlock the secret 4th synth track - Light all 3 **Digital Altar** candles + incense for a secret Relic - Open `/console.html` to edit all 20 Ads, Directory Portals, Operator Tag & upload GIFs
